card.name: The word not after plural subjects
card.fires_on: The word "not" right after an auxiliary verb (are, have, should, do, would) when the subject is a plural or quantified noun such as "all races", "both", "each injection volume" or "all of the votes".

modes.label: General statements
modes.description: "not" after are, have, do or would following a plural or "all" subject in general prose.
modes.example: all races are<< not>> quite equal yet

modes.label: Dosing and preparation limits
modes.description: "should not" after a volume or patient group in label instructions.
modes.example: Each injection volume should<< not>> exceed 2 mL
